newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse struggles to scale new heights.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse struggles to scale new heights.

text.p: Lack of news in general and no fresh movement in the dollar or interest rates kept a lid on the Brussels bourse in morning trading on Wednesday, although underlying sentiment remained firm, traders said.
"We had another record yesterday, but there is really nothing to drive the market this morning. There is no news," one trader said.

The Bel-20 index of blue chip shares was 4.94 points or 0.22 percent higher at 2,285.71 at 0830 GMT with 10 gainers, five unchanged and five losers. The market set a new closing high of 2,280.77 and an intraday high of 2,289.88 on Tuesday.
Traders noted the index was in part being held back by the decline of energy utility Electrabel, which has a relatively high weighting, on a report it was to be merged with parent Tractebel.
Electrabel was down 0.9 percent at 7,770 francs.

On the positive side, non-ferrous metals firm Union Miniere was up one percent at 2,995 francs on a firm dollar, high zinc prices and a re-awakening of interest in the steadily improving company. Volume was solid at about 28,000 shares.
"People are starting to sit up and take notice of the company after years of neglect," one trader said.
Oil major PetroFina was slightly lower after the expiry of a share buying warrant on Tuesday.

The stock was 0.2 percent down at 12,425 francs. Although the buy warrant was for 12,500 francs, traders said the fee structure for professionals was such that they believed quite a large number of the warrants had been exercised.
Kredietbank was also slightly down, although traders said the 0.7 percent decline was a technical correction after several days of steady rises.
